subject: Evening soak: request for supplemental night credits (eveburst)
messages:
From: Amrita Desai <amrita@finlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finlytics.com
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening soak — quick top-up request

Hi Ben,

Quick note from our ops run this morning: the evening soak (scheduled 09/19 22:00 PT) for our microburst scenario shows we’ll likely exceed the trial allowance by ~36 hours of sustained token generation. We want to keep the run overnight to validate 99th-percentile latency under steady traffic.

Can we get a short supplemental credit top-up for that window (48h scope, ~6M tokens)? If useful I attached the trimmed POC plan and a usage snapshot from the last dry run.

What we need:
- 48h uplift effective 2025-09-19 22:00 PT
- Prefer a safety buffer (10%) for retries

We’re on a tight timeline to finalize SLA numbers for the enterprise pilot — appreciate any fast path you can offer.

Thanks,
Amrita Desai
Head of Platform — Finlytics
amrita@finlytics.com

Attachment: finlytics-poc-plan.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: night-snapshot-20250918.csv (text/csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Amrita Desai <amrita@finlytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evening soak — quick top-up request

Amrita — thanks for the note and the attachments.

We can support this through two options:
1) Temporary sandbox uplift (48h window) — quick approve from sales, immediate provisioning.
2) Short-term dedicated trial extension with guaranteed throughput and a small usage commit (~1 week) — requires Ops/Quota team sign-off.

To move fast, can you confirm the absolute token cap you want (6M + 10% = ~6.6M)? Also: do you need any special region routing (we can pin to us-west for lower p95)?

I’m looping in Jonas and Neha to confirm internal sign-off path and to get an operational ETA. If we can do the sandbox uplift I can approve directly today.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Ben / Neha —

I reviewed the POV plan. This looks like a typical evening microburst with predictable egress; sandbox uplift is fine. I’ll authorize a 48-hour sandbox supplement scoped to 6.6M tokens, pinned to us-west. Notes:
- No additional SLA required for this uplift.
- We’ll enable prefix caching for the run to avoid unnecessary token spend.
- Ops will provision the window and drop a telemetry hook for the Finlytics CS team.

Ben — can you confirm the billing label (promo code / internal credit bucket) you want to apply so we can track consumption to the DL-2025-8742 deal?

Jonas Weber

jonas@redwood.ai
